class Solution:
    def deleteMiddle(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if head.next == None:
            head = None
            return head
        count = 0
        curr = head
        while curr != None:
            count+=1
            curr = curr.next
        stop = count//2
        
        new_head = ListNode(head.val)
        oldcurr = head.next
        newcurr = new_head
        count1 = 0
        while oldcurr:
            count1+=1
            if count1 != stop:
                newcurr.next = ListNode(oldcurr.val)
                oldcurr = oldcurr.next
                newcurr = newcurr.next
            else:
                oldcurr = oldcurr.next
        return new_head

            palindromes.append(currstr)

            right = 1

                right+=1
                left+=1
            palindromes.append(currstr) 
        answer = ""

        for x in palindromes:
            if len(x) > maxl:
                answer = x
                maxl = len(x)

from collections import defaultdict
class Solution:
    def sortColors(self, nums: list[int]) -> None:
        map1 = defaultdict(int)
        map1[0] = 0
        map1[1] = 0
        map1[2] = 0
        for x in nums:
            map1[x] +=1
        left = 0
        right = 0
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            while map1[0] > 0:
                if nums[right] == 0:
                    temp = nums[left]
                    nums[left] = nums[right]
                    nums[right] = temp
                    map1[0] -= 1
                    left+=1
                right += 1
            right = left
            while map1[1] > 0:
                if nums[right] == 1:
                    temp = nums[left]
                    nums[left] = nums[right]
                    nums[right] = temp
                    map1[1] -= 1
                    left+=1
                right +=1
            right = left
        return nums

class Solution:
    def reverseList(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        if head is None:
            return head
        prev = head
        next1 = prev.next
        prev.next = None
        while next1 != None:
            temp = next1.next
            next1.next = prev
            prev = next1
            next1 = temp
        return prev
